senses.gloss: f. (= h. הַכְרָזָה; כרּז) proclamation announcing public sale, whence, auction, cmp. אִגֶּרֶת.—
units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 35b:4">B. Mets. 35ᵇ</cite> <he>ימי א׳</he> time appointed for public sale.
<cite ref="Ketubot 100b:14">Keth. 100ᵇ</cite> <he>נכסי דא׳</he> property sold at auction.
<cite ref="Ketubot 100b:14">Ib.</cite> for capitation-tax &c. we sell <he>בלא א׳</he> without previous announcement; a. fr.
